capabilities: Toggle checkboxes inside Markdown table cells
Set custom task statuses from a right-click menu
Preserve single-character status markers in the Markdown source
Render status icons through the theme's data-task styling
Flag unrecognized status characters with an Important indicator
disambiguation: Not a task-management or query plugin; it only renders interactive checkboxes and preserves status characters in the source.
extras: Status icons come from the user's checkbox theme, not the plugin; with the default theme statuses round-trip in source but render as plain checkboxes. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It also adds a right-click status menu to ordinary block-list tasks, so you can set any status
problem: Markdown table cells are inline-only, so tasks written in a cell render as dead text that cannot be toggled, and Obsidian's task lists offer no custom statuses.

relations.evidence: Minimal — works out of the box. This is the theme the plugin is developed against.
Prism renders them once you install the Style Settings plugin and enable Prism → "Enable Prism Alternative Checkboxes"

summary: Task checkbox plugin that makes checkboxes interactive inside Markdown table cells and adds custom task statuses via a right-click menu.
